checklist.item: Converted it into an MoE (and grew that MoE)
It continued to train after conversion
The loss dropped below where the dense model was
Bigger model at the same compute per token

checklist.detail: peak 5.14 GiB allocated on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Laptop GPU

P1.claim: MoE-8 is back below the dense model's T1 val loss within the first 25% of Stage 2.
P1.measured: best val in first 25% 1.7575 vs dense T1 1.7737

P2.claim: CORE CRITERION: every MoE stage ends below its own conversion-point val loss, and MoE-32 at T3 is below dense at T1.

P3.claim: At T3 MoE-32 beats the dense control: paired per-batch mean difference < 0 and its 95% bootstrap CI excludes 0.

P4.claim: Balancing lab: with no balancing some layer ends with >= 1 nearly-dead expert; with the bias method no layer does, and its mean MaxVio is the lowest of the three.

P5.claim: At the start of Stage 3 (hard top-k, router tiled with small noise) more than 50% of tokens put all 4 picks inside one clone family.

P6.claim: Growth lab: copy + hard top-k ends with more nearly-dead experts (summed over layers) than drop + Gumbel top-k.

P7.claim: Growth lab: staggered-bias copy ends the lab window at a val loss at or below drop + Gumbel.

P8.claim: Router lab: sigmoid ends with a lower mean MaxVio than softmax under the same bias balancing.

P9.claim: Consecutive tokens share their first-choice expert more often than chance in every middle layer.

P10.claim: Masking the least-used half of the routed experts in every layer raises MoE-32 val loss by less than 5% (relative).

P11.claim: Removing the 3 most-used routed experts raises val loss more than the mean of 5 random triples.

P12.claim: Capacity factor 1.0 (tokens dropped) gives a higher val loss than dropless routing.

P13.claim: Post-hoc: growing 8 -> 32 by plain copies (hard top-k) beats the registered MoE-32 (drop + Gumbel) at T3: paired mean difference < 0 and its 95% CI excludes 0.

P14.claim: Post-hoc: MoE-8 simply continued to T3 (no growth) beats the registered MoE-32 at T3.

P15.claim: Post-hoc: neither post-hoc MoE beats the dense control at T3 (paired mean difference >= 0 for both).
P15.measured: vs dense control: copy-grown +0.0148, MoE-8 continued +0.0031
